subject: Contactless locker solution for swag dropoff at BrightCity — quote & layout
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: PocketLockers Inc. <ops@pocketlockers.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: contactless locker rentals for BrightCity swag dropoff

Hi Marco —

We run the swag program for BrightCity Conference (May 14–16). Venue has tightened vendor access and is encouraging contactless solutions for exhibitor swag distribution. We heard about PocketLockers from a partner and wanted a quick feasibility check:

- Can you do a temporary locker bank (30–40 small lockers + 6 large) inside Hall C for a 3-day event?
- Do you provide staffed on-site support for first-day setup and a 24/7 remote support line?
- Typical lead time and power/network requirements?
- Quote ballpark for rental + delivery + daily onsite staffing.

Attached: short site map + high-level goals. Our events manager (Laura) is on copy — if this looks possible we’ll route budget and confirm exact qty.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Events Ops | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: site-map-brightcity.pdf (site map stub)

From: Marco Alvarez <ops@pocketlockers.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCity Convention Center <venueops@brightcitycc.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: contactless locker rentals for BrightCity swag dropoff

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the details — PocketLockers can absolutely support that footprint. Summary below (see attached quote PDF):

- Config: 34 small (12x12x12in) + 6 large (24x18x18in) on two modular banks placed near Hall C north entry.
- Delivery & install: we require 2 loading dock passes; one 4-hr install window the day before show + 1-hr teardown after the final day.
- Staffing: on-site technician for setup (8 hrs) + remote hotline during show hours; add-on for in-person fulfillment staff at $45/hr per person.
- Power/network: 1 standard outlet per bank; we can operate offline but recommend a cellular hotspot for SMS codes.
- Lead time: 10 business days to confirm; expedited 5-business-day option at +25%.
- Ballpark cost: $5,600 rental + $950 delivery/install + $1,200 staffing (onsite tech + hotline) = $7,750 before taxes.

I attached the formal quote (PocketLockers-quote-0421.pdf) and a proposed floor layout (locker-layout-v3.png). We can issue a PO-ready invoice once you confirm quantity and staffing level.

—Marco
Marco Alvarez
Operations Manager, PocketLockers Inc.
ops@pocketlockers.com | +1 (206) 555-7890

Attachments: PocketLockers-quote-0421.pdf, locker-layout-v3.png

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PocketLockers quote — please review and confirm

Laura / Ben —

Forwarding PocketLockers quote and layout. Quick asks:

- Laura: can we get venue sign-off on the two-bank placement near Hall C north entry? I’ve looped venue ops in Marco’s reply but they tend to be slow.
- Ben: please confirm whether the locker dims work for our speaker gift boxes (we plan to ship boxes ~14x10x6in). If not, we either bump small->large qty or adjust packaging.

If you both ok the layout/qty I’ll request a PO and ask Marco to hold the units. Budget estimate: ~$8k.

Thanks —
Rachel

> On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 10:05 AM PocketLockers Inc. <ops@pocketlockers.com> wrote:
> Hi Rachel —
> 
> Thanks for the details — PocketLockers can absolutely support that footprint...

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: PocketLockers quote — please review and confirm

Quick check — measurements look fine for the small lockers IF we ship the speaker gift boxes on their side (14x10x6 fits diagonally) but we shouldn’t pack the lanyard add-on inside them. If we need bulkier sponsor kits (22x14x4) we should convert 10 of the smalls to larges.

Also: carrier BlueLine Freight flagged that shipments to the convention loading dock require a carrier appointment and a non-resident delivery permit. We should plan for that in the PO.

I recommend we do: 28 small + 12 large (shift 6 small->large) to keep locker turnover smooth and accommodate both speaker boxes and sponsor crates. Ballpark cost will go to ~$9,900.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Logistics Coordinator | Redwood Inference

From: BrightCity Convention Center <venueops@brightcitycc.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marco Alvarez <ops@pocketlockers.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: contactless locker rentals for swag dropoff at BrightCity — quote & layout

Hi Rachel / Marco —

Thanks for the heads-up. The north entry location is acceptable but please note:

- You must submit a Site Services request form and include an equipment diagram no later than May 6.
- Loading dock appointments are required (BlueLine should book 'Exhibitor Load-in' slot).
- No external staffing allowed in Hall C before 0700; install window the day prior may begin at 0900.

We’ll provision one dedicated power circuit near location — confirm exact plug type. Send final layout and PO number once available.

—Carolyn (Facility Ops Manager)
BrightCity Convention Center

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marco Alvarez <ops@pocketlockers.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@lumencreative.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: confirm 28 small + 12 large lockers — request PO and expedited lead time

Thanks all — decision: we’ll proceed with 28 small + 12 large (Ben’s recommendation) and we want the expedited 5-business-day install (eventship arrives May 11 — we need units onsite May 13). Marco, please send an updated PO-ready invoice and confirm expedited surcharge.

Olivia (design) — please check the locker front panel artwork in the Drive link and confirm safe-to-print by EOD Fri so vendor can do vinyl wraps ahead of delivery.

I attached a draft PO for internal approval (PO-draft-BC-0427.docx). I’ll submit the venue Site Services request once we have the PO number.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Events Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: PO-draft-BC-0427.docx, link to locker artwork: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_layout
